lesson: The system is consistently attempting to front-run liquidity sweeps in a trending market, resulting in 10 consecutive stop-outs as price continues to follow the higher timeframe (HTF) bearish momentum. By prioritizing localized 15m/30m reversals over the dominant 4h/1d markdown phase, the strategy is effectively catching falling knives.
adjustment: Implement a strict 'HTF Alignment Filter' where all entries must align with the 4h EMA trend direction, prohibiting counter-trend trades regardless of localized liquidity sweep signals.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweep signals LESS when the 4h/1d structure is in a confirmed markdown phase.
